The PIYA botanical index

Powerful plants. Thoughtful care.

Meet the four Ayurvedic botanicals at the heart of PIYA—chosen for generations of trusted use and their place in modern skin rituals.

Explore the ingredients ↓

Tradition,
understood more deeply.

These botanicals are more than a trend. Their naturally occurring compounds help cleanse, calm, brighten and support the skin.

PIYA brings their time-honored qualities into considered formulas made for everyday use. Always review the complete ingredient list on the product page and patch test when introducing something new.

01 · Curcuma longa

Turmeric

The golden root treasured in Ayurveda and Traditional Chinese Medicine, turmeric is known for curcumin—its naturally antioxidant and anti-inflammatory active.

Why skin loves it

  • Helps calm visible redness and irritation
  • Defends against environmental oxidative stress
  • Supports brighter, more even-looking skin
  • Helps clarify blemish-prone and oily skin

In skincare: Used as powder, extract, essential oil or advanced nano-curcumin. Raw turmeric can stain, so well-formulated products are best.

02 · Azadirachta indica

Neem

Revered in Indian medicine as the “miracle tree,” neem contains nimbin, nimbidin, azadirachtin, flavonoids and nourishing fatty acids.

Why skin loves it

  • Helps target blemish-causing bacteria
  • Soothes the look of irritated skin
  • Supports a purified, clarified complexion
  • Nourishes dry skin and strengthens its moisture barrier

In skincare: Found as leaf extract, oil and powder. Concentrated neem oil is intense and is best used diluted in a balanced formula.

03 · Ocimum tenuiflorum

Tulsi

Also known as Holy Basil, tulsi is an Ayurvedic staple rich in eugenol, ursolic acid, rosmarinic acid and protective flavonoids.

Why skin loves it

  • Helps keep acne-causing bacteria in check
  • Calms visible redness and sensitivity
  • Offers antioxidant protection from daily stressors
  • Balances excess oil and revives dull-looking skin

In skincare: Used as leaf extract, powder or properly diluted essential oil. Professionally formulated products offer the most comfortable everyday use.

04 · Crocus sativus

Saffron

Harvested from the delicate stigmas of the saffron crocus, this precious botanical has a long beauty tradition and is naturally rich in crocin, crocetin and safranal.

Why skin loves it

  • Encourages a luminous, refreshed appearance
  • Helps improve the look of uneven tone
  • Provides antioxidant support
  • Comforts mild visible inflammation

In skincare: Most often infused into oils or used in fine powder form. Concentrated preparations may not suit extremely sensitive skin.

Botanical wisdom,
made beautifully usable.
